subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the macOS owner accept these three upstream Swift package upgrades once the current-head native checks complete, or require a native launch/update smoke proof first?
rationale: The dependency constraints are compatible on paper, but accepting grouped upstream native dependencies requires ownership judgment about the appropriate level of macOS runtime validation.

options.title: Require native validation before merge
options.body: Wait for the current-head macOS Swift/build jobs and attach or accept a concise native launch or updater smoke result before merging.

options.title: Accept CI-only evidence
options.body: Merge after the native jobs pass, accepting the ordinary upstream dependency-update risk without additional runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Require native validation before merge
recommendation.body: Wait for the current-head macOS Swift/build jobs and attach or accept a concise native launch or updater smoke result before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence adjacent ownership and explicit PR routing make steipete the best available macOS decision contact.
